top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) is a distinct invention, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms in the Lamb-Dicke regime, that reached about 1e-18 uncertainty and has been reproduced and surpassed by independent laboratories. The two-name allocation follows concept and record performance, the citation can separate it from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, and seven of eight members support it. P002 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) is a major conceptual advance but its credit is less clean because the BHZ proposal guided the HgTe experiment and Zhang died in 2018, and it is close to the 2016 prize. An award is preferable to no award.
